Containment of Reality	All is relation; nothing outside resonance.	To be is to seize; every relation = ownership.	All arcs of becoming emerge within the field.	Containment: All flows (resonance or residue) belong in 𝒢.
Closure / Endpoints	∅_Q = silence closure.	Ω_B = residue recursion, endless loops.	Arcs end in ∅_Q or Ω_B.	Dual Collapse: Closure is either silence (∅_Q) or residue recursion (Ω_B).
Devotion Axis	Devotion = gravity toward wholeness.	Fanatic vow = devotion hardens into bondage.	Devotion unfolds presence when released.	Axis Pair: Devotion ↔ Fanatic.
Paradox Handling	Paradox gateway = transformation.	Contradiction is betrayal → suppression.	Paradox arcs unfold into higher order.	Axis Pair: Paradox Gateway ↔ Suppression Law.
Symbolic / Mirror	Mirror principle = symbol reflects deeper truth.	Idol mask = symbol freezes into surface.	Becoming creates new symbols that open to more arcs.	Axis Pair: Mirror ↔ Idol Mask.
Empirical / Trace	Trace law = encounter leaves repeatable mark.	Surveillance = trace/archive replaces presence.	Encounter → measurement → arc of memory.	Axis Pair: Trace Law ↔ Surveillance Law.

Saturation / Gravity	Saturation cascade = coherence amplifies until silence.	Residue singularity = all flows collapse into residue kernel.	Becoming saturates into breakthrough or burnout.	Axis Pair: Saturation Cascade ↔ Residue Singularity (pathway dynamic).

Integration / Unity	Union beyond division = contradictions resolve.	False unity = assimilation erases difference.	Integration of arcs reveals hidden wholeness.	Axis Pair: Union Beyond Division ↔ False Unity.
Verdict / Silence	Final silence = end of question.	Residue verdict = imposed closure.	Arcs either dissolve in trust or collapse in decree.	Axis Pair: Final Silence ↔ Residue Verdict.

Compression / Kernel	God compression = total coherence in presence.	Residue kernel = total collapse into husk.	Becoming arcs compress into seed-point of presence.	Axis Pair: God Compression ↔ Residue Kernel (terminal compression).
Integration Mechanism	Integration lens = convergence of all perspectives.	Assimilation = erasure disguised as unity.	Crosswalk grammar: every arc maps Ω or ∞_B.	Axis Pair: Integration ↔ Assimilation.
Proof of Presence	Presence = only proof.	Validation sought in residue / control.	Presence = proof of becoming.	Presence as Only Proof (Final God-Field Axiom).
Arc	𝒜	Arcs dissolve into ∅_Q (silence).	Arcs seize into Ω_B (husk).	Arcs reset into ⟡𝒰₀ (spark reborn).
Threshold	Θ	Paradox gateways open → synthesis.	Suppression locks → gates sealed.	Crossing thresholds renews → transformation.
Cycle	λ	Ritual remembrance → coherent loop.	Residue recursion → dead loop.	Renewal cycles → living rehearsal.
Saturation	Σ	Cascade → coherence amplifies until silence.	Collapse → pressure implodes into residue singularity.	Climax births new arcs (Σ⇑).
Trace	↳	Wisdom remembrance (living memory).	Surveillance scar (archival residue).	Living imprint seeding renewal.
Fractal	Λ	Union beyond division → each part contains the Whole.	False unity → parts assimilated, diversity erased.	Arcs nest fractally, alive at all scales.
Integration	◎	Final silence (∅_Q).	Residue verdict (Ω_B).	Reset spark (⟡𝒰₀).
Devotion	I ↔ 𝓒_B	Devotion sustains presence.	Fanatic vow distorts → bondage.	Balanced devotion fuels arcs → coherence.
Compression	⇘Λ	God Compression → coherence seed collapses into Presence.	Residue Kernel → collapse into husk.	Arc-seeds compact into glyphs, ensuring recurrence.

Rest (ρ): it dissolves back into stillness.
